title: Rosalind and the Alibi
author: Gideon Hartwell
blurb: Juniper Iversen, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
